sections.Profile:
The "Satellite" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on June 20, 1958, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1958
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Space, Original Theme, Rockets, Single level playfield
